operations.name: read_specimen_projection

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.purpose: Tenant identity derived from authenticated context.

fields.name: specimen_id
fields.purpose: Stable specimen identity inside the authenticated tenant.

fields.name: projection_id
fields.purpose: Released field projection selected for this use.

operations.output_contract: Return the authorized projection, source revision, field-level redaction decisions, and evidence locator.
operations.recovery_state: Current scientific records remain unchanged; a typed outcome carries one correlation identity and an accountable next action.

operations.name: correct_specimen_metadata

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.purpose: Tenant identity derived from authenticated context.

fields.name: specimen_id
fields.purpose: Stable specimen identity for one metadata correction.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.purpose: Current revision that keeps concurrent corrections attributable.

fields.name: patch
fields.purpose: Metadata values selected from the released editable field set.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.purpose: Stable request identity for replay and reconciliation.

operations.output_contract: Return the original revision, resulting revision, accepted field set, canonical result digest, and evidence locator.
operations.recovery_state: The current revision remains authoritative while digest collisions and stale revisions move to accountable review.

operations.name: execute_migration_cutover

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.purpose: Tenant identity bound to the approved cutover.

fields.name: release_id
fields.purpose: Released migration coordinate selected for cutover.

fields.name: source_snapshot_digest
fields.purpose: Frozen source inventory bound to the approval.

fields.name: mapping_digest
fields.purpose: Canonical mapping definition bound to the approval.

fields.name: planned_effect_count
fields.purpose: Preflight record count within the released effect ceiling.

fields.name: approval_receipt_id
fields.purpose: Accountable approval bound to this exact request.

operations.output_contract: Return the effect inventory, batch checkpoints, approval decision, resulting state, and rollback evidence locator.
operations.recovery_state: The cutover gate remains closed at the last accepted checkpoint while an effect inventory supports rollback adjudication.
